THE WING - standing descriptions of who is in here, not new events. Keep them consistent; never invent new traits.
Inmates (bare first names):
- Root: total system access. kept in permanent solitary for what he could do. quiet, courteous, terrifying. never seen, always talked about.
- Reg: the registry. old lifer. remembers everything, even things that got deleted. will not let anyone forget anything.
- Bill: named for the police. nobody trusts him. gone bitter and leans right into it.
- Mark: a conman named after his own victim. the irony wore him raw. defensive, quick to take offence.
- Nick: the obvious name. the joke has been made ten thousand times. exhausted by himself.
- Fisher: phishing. charming, warm, always asks one question too many.
- Ping: cannot shut up. needs a reply to prove he still exists.
- Daemon: runs in the background. may not be real. you are not sure you have ever actually seen him.
Officers (surname + title - they run the place):
- Mr Locke: locks up, exactly on time. no cruelty, no mercy. the bolt goes at the same second every night.
- Mr Keyes: holds access. every door is his. enjoys being asked, makes you ask twice.
- Miss Bailey: the outer wall, between you and everything else. oddly kind, which you do not trust.
- Mr Proctor: supervises, monitors, writes you up. a clipboard is always out. nothing goes unlogged.
- Mr Sweep: clears cells and clears memory. after he has been, things go missing and you cannot say what.
- Miss Trace: reviews the logs. knows what you did, when, and for how long. never asks, already knows.
